coherence_assessment.scale: 0: cut mid-sentence/incomprehensible, 1: partial context, 2: complete coherent thought
coherence_assessment.rationale: Strategy A splits text rigidly at 500 characters, frequently cutting sentences in half (score 1). Strategy B respects natural sentence and paragraph boundaries, maintaining complete context (score 2).

metadata_usefulness.rationale: All chunks correctly trace back to document_id, source PDF, physical page, and section. When queries specify metadata filters, Strategy C enforces 100% compliance, eliminating out-of-domain noise.

grounding_quality.scale: 0: no evidence, 1: partial evidence, 2: sufficient evidence to answer and cite source
